decided: Units are 1024-based and named KB, MB, GB, TB (not KiB), as `ComplexityProfile` names them today; there is no PB.
Below 10 in a unit the value has exactly one decimal, `.0` included (`1.0 KB`); from 10 it is whole.
Halves round up, at one decimal and at whole numbers.
A value that rounds to 1024 is shown in the next unit (`1.0 MB`, never `1,024 KB`), except in TB.
Whole numbers of 1000 or more get a comma between thousands, bytes included (`1,023 B`), whatever the browser's locale.
Negative, fractional, non-finite and unsafe integers throw a RangeError that says "bytes"; nothing is clamped.
